description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {R} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.name: Trazyn the Infinite
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with four or more charge counters on it
